facts.fact: 他在她公寓出现时，她正在给猫 Wilfred 喂晚饭，一开口就是「Are you ready?」
facts.anchor: Daniel shows up at my apartment the next night just as I’m giving Wilfred his dinner.

facts.fact: 昨晚他停下那个吻时说过的话，今天在她脑子里循环了一整天
facts.anchor: that being intimate now will only cause pain for both of us later

facts.fact: 他说今晚要去一个「双方都知道」的地方，还补了一句「Though for different reasons」
他解释收魂人能在人临终前的记忆闪回里看见她最亮的记忆，于是看见了那个湖
facts.anchor: There’s a moment just before death when the most important memories of a person’s life flash through their mind.

facts.fact: 他说当年在 Crescent City Hotel 收魂，是他少有的一次觉得在替死者讨正义
facts.anchor: It felt like I was helping the people who died here find justice.

facts.fact: 她在餐厅只点最便宜的面包棒加一份沙拉，坚持只在他真的付钱时才答应
facts.anchor: I’ll order the cheapest thing on the menu. Breadsticks. A side salad.

facts.fact: 他拒绝下水，说泡在水里会毁掉他此刻在她眼中的那个幻象
facts.anchor: Submerging myself will ruin the illusion.

facts.fact: 他推翻昨晚叫停的话，说她「vibrantly alive」，自己已经没法再抵抗
facts.anchor: “Devil take what I said last night,” he breathes.

facts.fact: 结尾他用一个吻结束这一夜，世界随之消失
facts.anchor: He chuckles, gives me one final, fierce kiss that steals my breath—and the world disappears.
